login.title: Sign in
login.locked: Too many failed attempts. Your account is temporarily locked.

register.title: Sign up
register.requireFields: Please fill in all required fields.
register.inviteRequired: An invite code is required for the selected role.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.success: If an account with address {{email}} exists, we sent a link to reset the password.
forgot.successHint: The link is valid for a limited time. Check your spam folder if the email doesn't arrive.

reset.successMessage: You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.title: Create a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.errorGeneric: Couldn't reset the password. The link may have expired.
reset.pwnedWarning: This password has appeared in breaches — please choose a different one.

mfa.otpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app or use a recovery code.
mfa.noMethods: No verification methods are available for this account.

errors.expired: The verification challenge expired. Please sign in again.
errors.missingChallenge: The selected verification method is no longer available.
errors.generic: Couldn't verify the security challenge. Try again.
errors.challengeLocked: Too many incorrect codes. Restart sign-in to request a new verification challenge.

descriptions.totp: Open your authenticator app and enter the current 6-digit code.
descriptions.recovery: Enter one of your unused recovery codes. Each code can be used once.

otp.recoveryWarning: Recovery codes can only be used once. Generate new codes after signing in.

webauthn.heading: Use your security key
webauthn.instructions: Touch your security key or use a built-in authenticator when prompted.

errors.denied: Authentication was cancelled or timed out.
errors.generic: Your security key couldn't be verified. Try again.

totp.instructions: Add this secret to your authenticator app if you can't scan the QR code.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.instructions: Store these codes in a safe place. Each code can only be used once.
recovery.warning: If you lose access to your authenticator and run out of codes, you may be locked out of your account.
recovery.empty: No recovery codes available yet. Generate a new set after setting up MFA.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.description: Sensitive changes require multi-factor authentication. Complete one of your security challenges to continue.
stepUp.requestFailed: Couldn't request an MFA challenge. Try again later.
stepUp.verifyFailed: Verification failed. Check the code and try again.
stepUp.missingChallenge: Couldn't find a matching challenge for that method.
stepUp.locked: Too many incorrect attempts. We've refreshed your security challenge.
